senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; כּוּשׁ II)Cushite, negro; Aethiopian.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:3">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:8">Cant. R. to II, 8</cite> (not <cite ref="K00424"><he>כותי</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="B01170"><he>בַּרְבָּרִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73">Gen. R. s. 73</cite>, end; a. fr. [<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite>, a. e. in later ed. <cite ref="K00402"><he>כושי</he></cite> for <cite ref="C00358"><he>גּוֹי</he></cite> or <cite ref="N00847"><he>נָכְרִי</he></cite>.]—

ib. 36ᵃ דומה לכ׳ a Palestinean Ethrog resembling an Aethiopian one; (oth. opin.) a real importation from Aethiopia. Y. ib. 53ᵈ אתרוג הכ׳ פסול the Aeth. Ethrog is ritually unfit; הבא מן הכ׳ כשר one of Palestinean growth descended from an Aethiopian Ethrog is available for ritualistic use.—Trnsf. abnormally dark-complexioned.
Ber. 58ᵇ; Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 3; a. e.—עֵין כּוּשִׁי pr. n. pl. En Kushi.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31a:11">Ab. Zar. 31ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. V, 44ᵈ <he>ע׳ כושי׳</he>; Y. Shebi. V, 36ᵃ top <he>ע׳ כּוּשִׁין</he>.
